parameters.name: after

code.description: One of the codes in ApiErrorCatalog (or a service's own).

ApiProblem.description: Every error of the API (application/problem+json). Some errors add members (for example tenants on TENANT_SELECTION_REQUIRED).

BadRequest.description: The request is invalid: a body, parameter or header that cannot be read or is refused (INVALID_REQUEST, REQUEST_VERIFICATION_FAILED without the CSRF token, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED, INVALID_ETAG, ...).

Conflict.description: A conflict: the Idempotency-Key was used for another request or is still running, or the record's state or version has moved on.

Forbidden.description: The caller's role or session may not do this (PERMISSION_DENIED), or another site started the request.

NotFound.description: The record named in the path does not exist for this tenant (RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND and the domain's own codes).

PreconditionFailed.description: If-Match names a version that is no longer the current one.

PreconditionRequired.description: If-Match is missing where the write needs it: always, or once a value is stored (PRECONDITION_REQUIRED).

TooManyRequests.description: Too many requests from this network or for this step (RATE_LIMITED).

Unauthenticated.description: No signed-in session or no tenant (AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED).

UnprocessableContent.description: The request was read but its values are refused (VALIDATION_FAILED and the domain's own codes).
